Title: usersApi.list renames perPage to the snake_case per_page query param
Steps: Call usersApi.list({ page: 1, perPage: 6 })
Expected: GET /api/auth/users called with per_page=6 and no perPage key

Title: usersApi.list forwards page search role status and sort verbatim
Steps: Call usersApi.list with every filter populated
Expected: params equal page/search/role/status/sort plus per_page with no key dropped

Title: usersApi.list omits the search param when the page clears the search box
Steps: Call usersApi.list with search=undefined
Expected: params.search is undefined so no search key reaches the wire

Title: usersApi.list unwraps the PagedUsers envelope keeping both data and meta
PreConditions: apiClient.get mocked, envelope carries one row
Steps: Call usersApi.list({ page: 2, perPage: 6 }) and await the result
Expected: resolves to the exact object with data length 1 and meta intact

Title: usersApi.list rejects with ApiError 400 carrying the backend message
Steps: Call usersApi.list with an unknown role and await the rejection
Expected: ApiError with status 400, message and traceId preserved

Title: usersApi.list rejects on HTTP 200 with success=false because the status code is not trustworthy
Steps: Call usersApi.list and await the rejection
Expected: ApiError with the backend message and traceId, which the page renders as the error row

Title: usersApi.list rejects when the envelope carries no data key at all
PreConditions: apiClient.get resolves an envelope without data
Steps: Call usersApi.list and await the rejection
Expected: ApiError with the message Phan hoi khong co du lieu

Title: usersApi.stats rejects with ApiError 500 carrying the message and traceId
Steps: Call usersApi.stats and await the rejection

Title: usersApi.deleteUser resolves undefined because the backend answers data null

Steps: Render UserManagementPage at /admin/users

Expected: admin-users-loading row present and stat cards read 0, then admin-users-empty row and a disabled select-all

Expected: admin-users-error row shown, zero admin-users-row elements, stat cards still populated

Steps: Type a search term, change role status and sort, then open page 2

Title: UserManagementPage fans a bulk action out to one mutation per selected id and re-queries

Steps: Tick two rows, click bulk lock, then repeat for bulk change role
Expected: updateStatus called once per id with status=suspended, selection cleared, and the users query invalidated afterwards

Title: UserManagementPage sends the right status per row action and renders both modals
PreConditions: usersApi update mocks plus a rejected write
Steps: Click approve, lock and unlock, trigger a rejected write, open both modals
TestData: statuses active, suspended and a rejection
Expected: PATCH sends active for approve and unlock and suspended for lock, the table survives the rejection, detail and reset modals render with their fallbacks

Title: /admin/users renders the stat cards the user table and the detail modal
PreConditions: web-admin storageState, GET /api/auth/users and /stats mocked, 12 synthetic e2e rows
Steps: 1. Visit /admin/users 2. Wait for the table 3. Assert stat cards, badges, action set, detail modal
Expected: Five stat cards (18/10/5/3/2), six rows, per-row role and status badges, lock/unlock/approve only on the matching status, detail modal with role, status, IP 10.0.0.9 and em-dash phone, console errors=0

Title: /admin/users re-queries on search role and sort paginates and bulk-locks via an intercepted endpoint
PreConditions: web-admin storageState, list and stats mocked, PATCH /status /role and DELETE intercepted locally
Steps: 1. Visit /admin/users 2. Search Nguyen, filter instructor, sort name_asc 3. Go to page 2 4. Select two rows and bulk lock
TestData: search=Nguyen, role=instructor, sort=name_asc, rows e2e-07 and e2e-08
Expected: Each new filter re-queries with its param, the first row changes from Nguyen Van A to Le Van C under name_asc, page 2 shows 7-12, and exactly two intercepted PATCH calls carry {status:suspended}
